tips.text: Run Radiant relics in a four-player radshare to chase the Rare Blade.
Refine Blueprint and Blade relics to Radiant and leave Handle relics Intact; Radiant lowers Common odds to 16.67%.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you keep the item and they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Bank Aya before her rotation opens; it never expires.
Buy extra relics for Masseter Prime Blade; it is the Rare part in every one of them.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
